cases.title: Luhn checksum validation
cases.prompt: Create luhn.py with is_valid(value). Treat value as a textual identifier. Ignore ASCII spaces, reject every other non-digit character, and reject identifiers containing fewer than two digits after spaces are removed. Starting from the right, double every second digit; subtract nine when doubling exceeds nine. Return True only when the transformed digit sum is divisible by ten. The function must be deterministic, must not mutate external state, and must not perform file or network access.
constraints: ASCII spaces are the only permitted separators
linear time and linear-or-better auxiliary space
cases.complexity_target: O(n) time; O(n) or O(1) auxiliary space
reviewer_rubric: spacing is normalized before parity is computed
doubling starts with the second digit from the right

cases.title: Minesweeper board annotation
cases.prompt: Create minesweeper.py with annotate(board). Each input string is one board row containing only spaces and asterisks. Return a new rectangular board where mines remain asterisks and each empty cell becomes the decimal count of adjacent mines in the eight surrounding positions; cells with zero neighboring mines remain spaces. An empty board is valid. Raise ValueError with a non-empty message when row widths differ or an unsupported character appears. Do not mutate the input list.
reviewer_rubric: all eight neighbor offsets are considered
bounds checks do not wrap negative indices

cases.title: Matrix row and column views
cases.prompt: Create matrix.py with matrix_views(text). Parse a non-empty newline-separated matrix whose cells are signed base-10 integers separated by one or more spaces. Return a dictionary with keys rows and columns. rows preserves the parsed row order; columns contains top-to-bottom column lists from left to right. Reject blank rows, non-integers, empty input, or inconsistent row widths with ValueError. Do not use NumPy or any third-party dependency.

Return a normal dictionary mapping normalized words to counts; an input with no words returns an empty dictionary.

cases.title: Run-length codec

For operation decode, expand decimal counts followed by a character; an absent count means one. Empty input returns an empty string. operation must be exactly encode or decode, otherwise raise ValueError. Inputs for decoding contain letters, spaces, and well-formed positive counts; counts may have multiple digits.

cases.title: Square-matrix diagonal difference

reviewer_rubric: absolute value is applied after subtraction

cases.title: Merge overlapping intervals
cases.prompt: Create intervals.py with merge_intervals(intervals). Each interval contains two integers start and end with start <= end. Reject malformed intervals with ValueError. Do not mutate the input or its nested lists.
cases.complexity_target: O(n log n) time; O(n) output space

cases.title: Sum of multiples below a limit
cases.prompt: Create euler_multiples.py with sum_multiples(limit, divisors=(3,5)). Sum each non-negative integer strictly below limit that is divisible by at least one supplied divisor. Count shared multiples once. Ignore duplicate divisors, reject zero or negative divisors with ValueError, and return zero when limit is non-positive. The implementation should avoid building a list proportional to limit when an arithmetic-series inclusion-exclusion approach is practical.
constraints: limit may be as large as 10**12
one or two positive divisors in evaluation
cases.complexity_target: O(1) for two divisors; no O(limit) allocation
reviewer_rubric: least common multiple prevents double counting

cases.title: Even Fibonacci sum below a limit

Return zero for limits at or below two. Do not use recursion that grows exponentially, do not materialize the full sequence, and support limits far larger than the classic example.
cases.complexity_target: O(log limit) sequence steps; O(1) space
reviewer_rubric: term equal to limit is excluded

best product is not confused with factors
